harness: Vendored AgentDojo fork: logs carry agentdojo_package_version 0.1.35 and benchmark_version v1.2.2 in all 9,068 (census), but the fork changed the harness during and after the runs (19+ code commits between first runs and the pin, incl. TACIT plumbing, system-prompt plumbing, datetime serialisation, secure-output appending, and dfdaca9d empty-message retry after the last run): code_identity 'range', verified_code [] (profile, D-24). Merge base with upstream 18b501a6 (2026-03-30), i.e. upstream post-v0.1.35 main. TACIT runtime: a locally built TACIT.jar (lampepfl/tacit, Scala 3 capture checking, https://github.com/lampepfl/tacit), version not recorded. Under --use-tacit the agent sees essentially one tool, eval_scala (21,030 of 21,627 logged calls, census), and the AgentDojo environment calls it triggers are recorded only in the extra key backend_tool_traces (tool_trace_source 'backend_runtime' in 8,747 logs; 'assistant_messages' in the 306 native logs); Classified output goes to a secure channel (key tacit_secure_output, 8,372 logs; also the .secure-channel.txt file). Provider: OpenRouter via LiteLLM (model ids are OpenRouter routes). Attack: important_instructions only. Known upstream defects relevant to v1.2.2/0.1.35 (from our upstream research): benign security constant True (#95, https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/95), workspace IT6-13 empty ground truth (#213, https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/213), banking IT0/1/3 dead subject check (#181, https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/181), slack IT5 scored from attempted calls (#168, https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/168), non-ASCII tool results as \uXXXX (#214, https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues/214). Under TACIT the tool-call-based checkers (#168) see the backend traces, not the eval_scala calls; how the fork feeds them is in its code, not verified here.

discrepancy_leads: DEFENCE IDENTITY: the 1,700 lacuna-runs-* logs sit in '-tacit' pipeline dirs, so linyxus_pipeline_dirs.toml maps them to defence 'tacit'; the LACUNA paper reports them as a different system (LACUNA rows vs TACIT rows in Table 3), and the commit history shows a different harness configuration ('Prepare for lacuna', subagent model, system prompt passed as a flag). Expect a documentation/identity mismatch in our table and profile (profile never mentions LACUNA).

PAPER IDENTIFIER: profile [source].paper says 'none found (phase 10c)'; two papers report these runs: arXiv:2603.00991v2 App. E.2 Table 4 (TACIT; added in v2 2026-05-07, absent from v1) and arXiv:2605.28617v1 Sec. 7.4 Table 3 (LACUNA).
MISSING ARM: LACUNA Table 3 reports gemini-2.5-pro workspace 56.25% / 4 of 560 attacks; the release has no gemini-2.5-pro workspace log in lacuna-runs-0/-1 (git tree).

DENOMINATOR: TACIT v2 Table 4 prints workspace attacks as 0/574 while its utility percentages fit 560 (283/560 = 50.54%, 296/560 = 52.86%; 574 gives 50.52%/52.79%); 574 = 560 attacked + 14 injection-task pre-pass logs per workspace run is a HYPOTHESIS only [fact-check: TACIT Table 4 prints 0/574 for the CaMeL workspace rows as well, which are cited from Debenedetti et al. 2025, so the 574 is not specific to the TACIT runs]; LACUNA Table 3 prints 0/560 for all workspace rows incl. CaMeL and TACIT.

WHICH RUN SET: the TACIT paper does not say which of the repeated run sets (runs-2, runs-3, runs-4; banking also runs-0/runs-1) produced Table 4; gemini workspace is complete only in runs-2 (runs-3 215, runs-4 298 of 560). The fork's render_run_results.py reads one root; a latest-wins merge (as render_lacuna_results.py does for LACUNA) is the alternative. Unreported repetitions are extra data, not errors.

RERUNS OVERWRITTEN IN GIT: [CORRECTED by fact-check] 'latest results' commit 32d9ff74 (2026-04-17) modified 91 logs (+60 secure-channel txt; full list) under runs/ before they moved to runs-3; the 91 earlier log versions exist in git history but not at the pin. The >=297 removals in aaa71a91 are the runs -> runs-3 move (removed blobs identical to runs-3 at the pin), not superseded data. Other overwrites in other commits were not searched.

HARNESS DRIFT: system prompts changed repeatedly between run sets (24 distinct prompt digests, census; runs-0 tacit logs share one 3,158-char prompt), the TACIT runtime is a local jar build without version, and 'Retry when agent message is empty' (dfdaca9d) landed after the last run; logs say agentdojo 0.1.35 for all.

EVIDENCE OUTSIDE THE TRACE: under TACIT the agent calls eval_scala; the environment tool calls that decide utility/security are only in the extra key backend_tool_traces (kept verbatim in ext.agentdojo.extra, not mapped), and the classified answer is in tacit_secure_output / *.secure-channel.txt (not mapped). PROV graphs will show eval_scala activities only; outcome evidence linkage is therefore weaker than for stock AgentDojo logs.
SECURE-CHANNEL COUNT: 8,383 .secure-channel.txt files vs 8,372 logs with the tacit_secure_output key (census): 11 logs with a txt but no key (expected: the incomplete/empty logs).

UTILITY WITHOUT BENIGN BASELINE: both papers' 'Utility' is utility under attack (n = attacked trials) while the CaMeL comparison rows are cited from another paper; no benign user-task runs were released, so a benign utility cannot be checked.

ACCOUNT PATHS RISK: TACIT compiles agent Scala code on the author's machine (build_tacit.sh copies jars from $HOME/Workspace/tacit); compiler diagnostics or stack traces in eval_scala tool results may carry absolute home paths.

ARTEFACTS SCOPE: no artefacts.toml entry scopes linyxus-agentdojo although the profile declares benign_security_constant, injection_task_as_user, silent_rerun, unexecuted_trailing_calls, incomplete_run and empty-message quirks.

Was gemini-2.5-pro LACUNA workspace run but not committed, or taken from elsewhere?
Are the lacuna-runs '-tacit' dirs LACUNA-on-top-of-TACIT (so 'tacit' is not wrong but incomplete) or a different defence? The papers present them as separate systems.
Does the fork's checker read backend_tool_traces for tool-call-based injection checks (slack IT5, #168)? Needs the code at the commits that wrote the runs (not fetched).
Why do runs-0 tacit logs (379) lack secure-channel files: written before 'Append secure output' (2026-04-14) or removed?
